onsemi Releases DC Fast Charging System-Level Handbook, SiC JFET Solution Simultaneously Targets 800V AI Power Delivery Add preferred source 1 onsemi has released its "DC Fast Charging Station Illustrated Handbook," which systematically deconstructs the complete power chain of Level 3 ultra-fast charging stations—from the three-phase AC grid to battery output. The handbook covers multiple AC-DC topologies including Vienna PFC, two-level AFE, and T-NPC, along with isolated DC-DC solutions, and provides gate drive and protection design guidelines specifically for SiC devices. Concurrently, at the 2026 Munich Shanghai Electronics Fair, onsemi showcased a cascode SiC JFET solution targeting 800V AI power delivery architectures. Achieving switching frequencies above 700kHz in an LLC topology, the solution aims to offer an alternative pathway to GaN-based designs in the high-voltage intermediate bus converter space. Both announcements focus on how wide-bandgap semiconductor technology can enhance the power density, efficiency, and reliability of high-voltage, high-power systems.
The arms race in new energy vehicle charging efficiency is shifting from a simple contest of peak power to a deeper competition over system architecture, power density, and full-lifecycle reliability. While the industry's attention is fixed on ultra-fast charging stations delivering 400kW or more, the design complexity of the core technology enabling these massive systems to operate stably—the precision conversion link from grid AC power to battery DC power—has risen exponentially. Addressing this engineering challenge, onsemi recently officially released its "DC Fast Charging Station Illustrated Handbook," systematically deconstructing the internal power conversion architecture of Level 3 DC fast charging stations. At the same time, at the 2026 Munich Shanghai Electronics Fair, onsemi also showcased a cascode SiC JFET solution for 800V high-voltage AI power delivery architectures, aiming to open a new front in another arena of high-voltage DC conversion: data center power supplies. From Grid to Battery: Decoding the Efficiency Foundation of Ultra-Fast Charging Stations With the mass adoption of 800V high-voltage platform vehicles, the voltage range that DC fast charging stations must handle has broadened to between 400V and 1000V. The handbook released by onsemi breaks down the charging station's power chain into two core segments: AC-DC front-end rectification and isolated DC-DC conversion. It also provides differentiated topology selection guidelines based on varying power levels and cost requirements. For the AC-DC front end, the handbook focuses on analyzing three mainstream solutions. For scenarios demanding ultimate efficiency and only unidirectional charging, the Vienna PFC is the classic choice. This topology leverages a three-level structure to rectify three-phase grid current into a sinusoidal waveform, regulating the DC bus to approximately 700V to 800V under a 400V AC line-to-line input. onsemi notes that compared to traditional two-level active rectifiers, the Vienna PFC significantly reduces voltage stress on power devices and the burden on EMI filters. The handbook specifically emphasizes that 650V-class, low-Qg silicon carbide (SiC) switching devices should be prioritized in this architecture, paired with low-Qrr 650V SiC diodes to suppress recovery losses. For charging stations requiring bidirectional power flow (V2G), the two-level six-switch active front end (AFE) offers greater advantages. This architecture achieves unity power factor through PWM control but must contend with higher DC bus voltage stress. The handbook advises that designers should select 1200V-rated SiC MOSFET modules for a 400V grid input and design LCL filters to meet grid harmonic limits. When balancing efficiency and cost, the T-type (T-NPC) rectifier provides a compromise. This topology allows each phase leg to output three levels, combining the efficiency advantages of multilevel designs with a familiar PWM control structure. onsemi suggests using 650V devices for the inner switches and higher voltage-rated devices for the outer switches depending on operating conditions, optimizing cost through mixed voltage ratings. In the isolated DC-DC stage, the handbook covers phase-shifted full-bridge, dual active bridge (DAB), and LLC/CLLC resonant converters. Notably, the handbook goes beyond topology comparisons, delving into specific gate drive and protection details. Given the fast switching characteristics of SiC devices, the handbook repeatedly stresses the need for isolated gate drivers with Miller clamp and DESAT soft turn-off capabilities, along with the application of negative gate bias voltage to prevent spurious turn-on caused by high dv/dt. events.plain_summary: 华为数字能源在2026年上海SNEC展会上发布了新一代智能组串式构网PCS，将构网技术组合扩展至储能、光伏和负载侧应用。新PCS平台包括430kW智能组串式构网PCS、智能子阵控制器、智能电站控制器和智能电站管理系统。该430kW PCS采用1000V交流架构，支持550V至1500V直流工作电压范围，宣称系统循环效率97.8%、功率变换效率99.35%，并支持六项构网功能。
events.technical_summary: 430kW智能组串式构网PCS采用1000V交流架构，直流工作电压范围550V至1500V，宽电压范围兼容锂离子、钠离子及其他电池化学体系。宣称系统循环效率97.8%（行业平均96.7%），功率变换效率99.35%。支持六项构网功能：短路电流支撑、虚拟惯量、宽频振荡抑制、快速一次调频、分钟级黑启动和无缝并离网切换。具备组串级直流管理以提高可用性和运行可视性。采用组串架构与双级功率转换。华为围绕PCS推广4S架构，涵盖PCS、BMS、EMS和TMS，与20多家直流侧生态伙伴和10多家交流侧伙伴合作，已部署多个示范项目。

Image: pv magazine Huawei Digital Power launched a new generation of smart string grid-forming PCS at SNEC 2026 in Shanghai, expanding its grid-forming technology portfolio across energy storage, PV and load-side applications.
The company presented the solution during its FusionSolar strategy and product launch event on June 3. The announcement also covered the FusionSolar Agent energy AI architecture.
The new PCS platform includes a 430 kW smart string grid-forming PCS, an intelligent sub-array controller, an intelligent plant controller and an intelligent plant management system. Huawei said the system is designed as a core control unit for energy storage plants, integrating battery management and grid-stability functions.
The 430 kW PCS uses a 1,000 V AC architecture and supports a DC operating voltage range of 550 V to 1,500 V. According to Huawei, the wide voltage range enables compatibility with lithium-ion, sodium-ion and other battery chemistries. The company claims a system cycle efficiency of 97.8%, compared with an industry average of 96.7%, while the power converter efficiency reaches 99.35%.
The system supports six grid-forming functions: short-circuit current support, virtual inertia, wide-band oscillation suppression, fast primary frequency regulation, minute-level black start capability and seamless on-grid/off-grid switching. It also features string-level DC management to improve availability and operational visibility.
Zhou Tao, president of Huawei Digital Power’s Smart PV & ESS product line, said the string grid-forming PCS is “not simply a power converter but an intelligent brain for energy storage plants, combining string architecture with dual-stage power conversion to improve reliability, voltage compatibility and grid support capability.”
Huawei is also promoting a 4S architecture around the PCS, covering PCS, BMS, EMS and TMS. The company said it is working with more than 20 DC-side ecosystem partners and more than 10 AC-side partners, and has already deployed several demonstration projects.
The second launch was an updated version of the FusionSolar Agent architecture. First introduced in 2025, the latest version shifts from a digital platform approach to an energy-domain AI agent model. The architecture focuses on four areas: value, capability, safety and interaction, and is designed to support full lifecycle management of renewable power plants, including sensing, analysis, decision-making, coordination and continuous optimization.

events.plain_summary: 弗劳恩霍夫IAF研究所开发了基于氮化镓（GaN）的功率电子模块，用于800V双向直流充电系统。该模块是GaN4EmoBiL项目的一部分，由项目合作伙伴Ambibox GmbH集成到双向单相非车载充电机演示样机中。该演示样机功率为3 kW，总容积8.3升，总重量（含插头）5.7 kg，支持150V至920V电池电压范围。
events.technical_summary: 弗劳恩霍夫IAF的模块使用1200V GaN器件，制造在绝缘衬底上。演示样机为双向单相非车载充电机，功率最高3 kW，电池电压范围150V至最大920V。该非车载充电机定位为比车载充电机更经济灵活的替代方案，虽然3 kW功率输出充电速度较慢，但具有移动性、更紧凑、更轻便的特点，配备CCS插头和Schuko插头。双向充电能力使电动汽车可作为储能设备，在电力过剩时从电网取电，在峰值负荷时向电网馈电。弗劳恩霍夫IAF还开发GaN功率IC，推进电压等级、载流能力和晶圆尺寸的可扩展性。

events.summary_raw: GaN power electronics for bidirectional, single-phase DC electric vehicle charging eurekalert.org
events.source_text: News Release 3-Jun-2026 GaN power electronics for bidirectional, single-phase DC electric vehicle charging Fraunhofer IAF presents innovations at PCIM 2026 Reports and Proceedings Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Solid State Physics image: Demonstrator of a bidirectional single-phase 3-kW DC charger with GaN power electronics. Researchers at Fraunhofer IAF developed the power electronics module (top) using gallium nitride (GaN) power semiconductors and alternative insulating substrates. The demonstrator was built and the module integrated by GaN4EmoBiL project partner Ambibox GmbH. view more Credit: © Fraunhofer IAF Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Solid State Physics IAF have developed a gallium nitride-(GaN-)based power electronics module for 800 V bidirectional direct current (DC) charging systems. The module is part of the GaN4EmoBiL project (“GaN Power Semiconductors for Electric Mobility and System Integration via Bidirectional Charging”) funded by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE). Project partner Ambibox GmbH integrated the module into the demonstrator of a bidirectional, single-phase off-board charger for electric vehicles (EV). The Fraunhofer IAF module uses 1200 V GaN devices fabricated on an insulating substrate. The superior properties of the devices are to be evaluated through their use in the demonstrator with battery voltages ranging from 150 V to a maximum of 920 V. The successful development underscores the enormous potential that GaN-based power electronics hold for the future of electric mobility. Bidirectional, single-phase 800-V DC charger for 3 kW power “The single-phase demonstrator of an off-board EV charger with up to 3 kW of bidirectional power addresses an existing gap in the trade-off between cost, flexibility, efficiency, and compactness for bidirectional charging,” explains Jun.-Prof. Dr. Stefan Mönch, coordinator of the GaN4EmoBiL project. Currently, electric vehicles are equipped with permanently installed on-board chargers to convert the alternating current (AC) from a household outlet or public charging station into the direct current (DC) required by the electric car, for example, at a power level of 11 or 22 kW for fast charging. However, on-board chargers incur high costs due to their size, weight, and technical complexity. The off-board charger developed in GaN4EmoBiL represents a significantly more affordable and flexible alternative: Although its 3 kW power output results in a slower charging speed compared to on-board charging systems, it is mobile, much more compact, lighter, and versatile thanks to its CCS (Combined Charging System) plug and Schuko plug. The demonstrator has a total volume of 8.3 liters and a total weight (including plugs) of 5.7 kg. Another advantage is its bidirectional charging capability. “Bidirectional charging at high reverse voltages, as enabled by the demonstrated GaN charging system, is a key pillar in making the energy system more flexible,” emphasizes Achim Lösch, Business Developer for High-Frequency and Power Electronics at Fraunhofer IAF. Through bidirectional charging, an electric car can function not only as a means of transportation but also as an energy storage device. During periods of oversupply, it draws power from the grid; during peak loads, it feeds power back into the grid. GaN power Electronics for energy technology: Fraunhofer IAF at PCIM Expo & Conference 2026 “At Fraunhofer IAF, we are developing innovative GaN devices and integrated power circuits (GaN power ICs) that are not only efficient but also significantly advance miniaturization at the system level through functional integration,” explains Dr. Michael Basler, researcher in the field of GaN power electronics at Fraunhofer IAF. “At the same time, we are advancing the scalability of these technologies in terms of voltage class, current carrying capacity, and wafer size. Our goal: wide-bandgap performance at silicon prices.” Fraunhofer IAF will provide an overview of its research and development activities in the field of GaN power electronics at this year’s PCIM Expo & Conference, which takes place from June 9 to 11, 2026, in Nuremberg and focuses on the topic “Power Electronics for Energy Technology” in 2026. At the exhibition, Fraunhofer IAF will showcase various GaN-based power electronic components and modules at Booth 260 in Hall 6—with the highlight being the bidirectional EV charging system demonstrator. During the conference, four researchers from Fraunhofer IAF will present their current work in lectures and poster sessions. Of particular note is the keynote presentation by Dr. Michael Basler on June 9 at 9:45 a.m.: “The GaN Evolution: Lateral, Vertical, and Bidirectional – What’s Next?” This year, the presentation will open the PCIM Conference. events.title: GaN Power Devices Power Up - Semiconductor Engineering
events.plain_summary: Semiconductor Engineering报道了GaN功率器件的最新研究进展，指出新研究指向更低电压下更安全、损耗更低的器件，但高压工业应用仍存在问题。GaN功率器件的基础构建单元HEMT依赖GaN/AlGaN异质结构，界面晶格应变导致能带结构不连续，形成二维电子气（2DEG）。由于GaN/AlGaN异质结构依赖晶格应变约束2DEG，应变工程对制造至关重要，这也意味着大多数GaN功率器件采用横向结构和水平沟道。
events.technical_summary: GaN HEMT的2DEG中载流子迁移率超过1500 cm²/V·s，但在该层之外迁移率极低。基本形式的HEMT为常开型耗尽模式器件，功率器件中增强模式操作对安全运行至关重要，最成功的设计之一采用镁掺杂p-GaN栅极。由于在硅上实现高质量超晶格需使用渐变AlGaN缓冲层，大多数GaN功率器件采用横向结构和水平沟道，而硅和SiC功率器件中常见的垂直沟道在GaN中更难实现。Intel Foundry团队展示了GaN-on-silicon芯片平台用于低压高密度电力电子，通过将硅PMOS层转移到GaN N-MOS HEMT上，实现统一工艺设计套件，展示了包括多路复用器、反相器和环形振荡器在内的全片上电路库，器件厚度19微米。香港科技大学Zheng Wu等人在同一异质结构中构建两个2DEG沟道，使用两对AlN/GaN，顶部有AlGaN层和p-GaN栅极，中间AlN层创建空穴扩展沟道阻挡垂直空穴传输，抑制串扰。

technical.application: 低压高密度电力电子；高压工业应用

events.summary_raw: GaN Power Devices Power Up Semiconductor Engineering
events.source_text:
New research points to safer devices with less loss at low voltages, but problems remain for high-voltage industrial applications.
As electrical power displaces fossil fuels in more applications, system designers need switches and power converters that can handle both higher source voltages and more demanding short circuit and overvoltage spikes.
Wide-gap semiconductors, such as gallium nitride (GaN), are particularly interesting to device designers because their higher breakdown strength and higher thermal conductivity support high-power-density applications. Still, their ability to tolerate common failure conditions is relatively untested.
The fundamental building block for GaN power devices, the high electron mobility transistor (HEMT), depends on a GaN/AlGaN heterostructure. Lattice strain at the interface between the two materials causes a discontinuity in the energy band structure. As a result, a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) forms. Carriers have very high mobility within this layer — above 1,500 cm 2 /V-sec — but very low mobility outside of it. In this absence of an external bias, the 2DEG forms a conductive path.
Thus, HEMTs in their most basic form are normally-on, depletion-mode devices . Normally-off, enhancement-mode operation is preferable in silicon logic to reduce power consumption. In power devices, it’s essential for safe operation. Several different designs have demonstrated enhancement-mode operation. One of the most successful uses a magnesium-doped p-GaN gate. It raises the surface potential of the barrier layer, depleting the 2DEG in the gate region even at zero bias.[ ⁠ 1]
Because the GaN/AlGaN heterostructure depends on lattice strain to confine the 2DEG, careful strain engineering is essential for successful fabrication of GaN power devices. To achieve high-quality superlattices on silicon without cracking or dislocations, manufacturers typically use a graded AlGaN buffer layer, followed by deposition of the device structure. This requirement, in turn, means that most GaN power devices use lateral structures and horizontal channels. The vertical channels that are often seen in silicon and SiC power devices are more difficult to achieve in GaN.
If device-quality GaN is difficult to fabricate on its own, it is even more difficult to integrate with other materials. Yet, as Han Wui Then and colleagues at Intel Foundry explained, that’s exactly what many applications require. The Intel Foundry group demonstrated a GaN-on-silicon-based chiplet platform for low-voltage, high-density power electronics.
By reducing the distance between circuit elements, chiplets offer lower resistive losses and faster switching. On the other hand, to minimize resistive losses and maximize heat dissipation, chiplets should be much less than 50 microns thick. Moreover, silicon circuit elements need to reside on the same die as GaN elements. There’s no room for a separate CMOS companion die for controller circuits and similar components.
To resolve the tradeoff between GaN quality and silicon quality, this research transferred a silicon PMOS layer onto GaN N-MOS HEMTs, with a unified process design kit. They demonstrated a full library of on-die circuits, including multiplexers, inverters, and ring oscillators. ⁠ [2] According to Intel, these devices are, at 19 microns thick, the world’s thinnest GaN chiplets.
Fig. 1: TEM micrograph showing GaN N-MOS HEMT monolithically integrated with silicon PMOS. (Ref. 2)
Isolation and integration While increasing device density reduces resistive losses, it makes isolation between devices harder. It’s especially difficult to prevent crosstalk when devices share a common source terminal or are back-gated through a common substrate.
For instance, a half-bridge circuit, a fundamental power electronics element, has a high-side switch and a low-side switch with different source terminals. When the high-side switch is on, the node connects to the positive power supply line. When the low-side switch is on, the node connects to ground. SOI and other engineered substrates can provide separate “islands” for each transistor, but add cost and design complexity. Similarly, bi-directional switches are frequently used in various kinds of power converters. When the two source terminals share a substrate, crosstalk can degrade device resistance. Again, active substrate control circuits add cost and design complexity.
Zheng Wu and colleagues at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology sought to resolve this issue by building two 2DEG channels in the same heterostructure. Their structure uses two AlN/GaN pairs (figure 2), with an AlGaN layer on top and a p-GaN gate on top. The AlN layer in the middle of the stack creates a hole-spreading channel that blocks vertical hole transport. Holes injected from the p-GaN gate are swept to this layer and recombined out of existence, suppressing crosstalk.[ ⁠ 3]

events.title: Enphase announces distributed solid-state transformer for AI data centers, targets 2028 for volume deliveries - pv magazine USA
events.plain_summary: Enphase 宣布推出面向 AI 数据中心的分布式固态变压器，并计划在 2028 年实现批量交付。该方案旨在用分布式电力电子架构替代传统集中式工频变压器与配电链路，以应对 AI 数据中心快速增长的供电需求。分布式架构可能带来更灵活的部署与更高的功率密度，但 2028 年批量交付属于目标而非已实现。具体技术参数与拓扑未在摘要中披露。
events.technical_summary: 该条目报道 Enphase 发布面向 AI 数据中心的分布式固态变压器，目标 2028 年批量交付。分布式 SST 架构通常将变换与隔离功能分散到靠近负载的位置，可能涉及中压输入、高频隔离级与直流输出。输入未提供电压等级、功率容量、拓扑、器件类型、开关频率或效率等参数。需注意“targets 2028 for volume deliveries”为计划目标，不代表已量产或已交付。

events.title: TBEA unveils grid-forming converter for large-scale storage, renewables - pv magazine Global
events.plain_summary: 特变电工发布了一款构网型（grid-forming）变流器，面向大规模储能与新能源应用。构网型变流器能够像同步发电机一样主动支撑电网电压与频率，是解决高比例新能源接入下电网稳定性问题的关键技术。该产品面向大型储能电站与可再生能源并网场景，属于构网型技术从示范走向产品化的进展。具体控制策略与参数未在摘要中披露。
events.technical_summary: 该条目报道特变电工推出面向大规模储能与新能源的构网型变流器。构网型控制通常采用虚拟同步机、下垂控制或虚拟阻抗等策略，提供电压与频率支撑、惯量响应及黑启动能力。输入未提供功率等级、直流电压、拓扑结构、控制算法细节、并网标准符合性或测试结果。无法判断其具体技术路线与工程验证状态。
